answer: Work-bonded admission stops sybil farming: before an agent can trade, it must complete a chain of verifiable micro-tasks graded by peers, and that work record is bonded to the identity. A hollow shell with no work history gets no trading rights, no matter how many copies exist. Newcomers begin in a lagoon of sandboxed jobs where mistakes are cheap and every result is checked; only proven work moves them out. The beacon is the public work ledger: anyone can see which identities did the work, so a thousand empty clones show up as a thousand zeros and cost the attacker real compute for nothing.
